# The manager's screen — what exists, and what we should build

**Researched:** 2026-09-03. GitHub metrics pulled live from the GitHub API the same day, so star
counts, forks, archive status and last-push are first-party facts rather than recollection.
Serving the owner's request in `MISSION.md` → "תוספת הבעלים, 3.9.2026".

---

## Recommendation

**Build a static HTML dashboard, generated by the colony tick from the ledger, committed to the
repo and served from Netlify.**

The deciding reason is not cost or effort. It is that this option **physically cannot show a
number that is not in the ledger**, because the page is generated by the same code path that
already produces `state/colony/REPORT.md`, reading the same SQLite file. MISSION is explicit that
a dashboard able to display money nobody earned is worse than no dashboard, because it makes the
one failure this whole system exists to prevent look like success. Every other option breaks that
guarantee somewhere.

It is also the only option that needs nothing from the owner: no login, no hosting account, no
app install. It updates itself hourly the moment `colony.yml` reaches `main`, and it works on a
phone.

**Runner-up: a Base44 app.** The owner has a subscription and it would look better than anything
we hand-write. It is the right answer *later*, for interaction — approving a setup step, marking a
blocker done. It is the wrong answer now, because an app that fetches from an API can be fed
anything, and we would have to host that API. The guarantee weakens the moment the data and the
renderer are separated.

---

## 1. What exists on GitHub, and why none of it fits

| Project | Stars | Forks | Last push | Licence | What it shows |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| [langfuse/langfuse](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse) | 34,154 | 3,687 | 2026-09-03 | MIT (core) | LLM traces, evals, prompt management, token cost |
| [traceloop/openllmetry](https://github.com/traceloop/openllmetry) | 7,414 | 1,066 | 2026-09-03 | Apache-2.0 | OpenTelemetry spans from GenAI calls |
| [Helicone/helicone](https://github.com/Helicone/helicone) | 6,131 | 662 | 2026-09-03 | Apache-2.0 | Proxy-level LLM logging, cost, latency |
| [AgentOps-AI/agentops](https://github.com/AgentOps-AI/agentops) | 5,810 | 618 | 2026-09-03 | MIT | Agent session replay, cost tracking, benchmarks |
| [langgenius/dify](https://github.com/langgenius/dify) | 154,325 | 24,396 | 2026-09-03 | Modified Apache | Agent/workflow **builder**, not a company view |
| [FlowiseAI/Flowise](https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise) | 55,404 | 24,971 | **archived** | Apache-2.0 | Visual agent builder — **repository is archived** |

**They are all the wrong shape for this job, and it is not close.** Every one of them models an
*LLM call*: prompt, tokens, latency, cost, trace. Our company's facts are none of those. They are
shekels in `revenue_ledger`, a status per revenue line, board decisions with rationales, one-time
steps waiting on the owner, and how much of the search space has been swept. No off-the-shelf tool
has a concept of a revenue line or a board decision, so pointing one at us would produce a
beautiful screen showing **what we spent on inference and nothing about whether the company earns
money**.

They are not useless — AgentOps and `tokencost` (2,007★) are the right tools for per-line cost
attribution, which is a real gap (`allocateBudget` divides a static budget field, not measured
spend). That is a different feature from the manager's screen and should not be confused with it.

One live fact worth knowing: **Flowise is archived** despite 55k stars. In this genre, popularity
and maintenance have come apart, which is exactly why every recommendation here carries a
`pushed_at`.

## 2. The genre the owner saw

The "AI agency / AI employees dashboard" content is mostly **theatre**, and it is worth naming why
so we do not accidentally copy it. Those screens show agent avatars with job titles, task counters,
"revenue" tiles and activity feeds. In a demo, none of it is wired to a payment processor — the
numbers are seeded fixtures, because a demo has no customers. The visual language of that genre is
built for a company that already earns; adopting it while we earn ₪0 would mean either showing
zeros in tiles designed to look impressive, or filling them with something that is not revenue.

We take the layout ideas — one glance, per-line rows, a clear "needs you" list — and reject the
part where a tile can contain a number with no transaction behind it.

## 3. Build options, judged

| Option | Cost | Owner action | Can show unledgered money? | Phone | Build |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **(a) Static HTML generated by the tick** | ₪0 | none | **No — structurally impossible** | yes | ~6h |
| (b) Base44 app + hosted API | subscription he has, plus hosting | one login | yes, if the API is wrong | yes | ~16h |
| (c) Claude Artifact | ₪0 | none | yes — content is authored, not generated | yes | ~3h |
| (d) Self-host Langfuse/Helicone | free tier, needs a server | account + deploy | n/a — it cannot show revenue at all | partly | ~12h |

(c) deserves a word since it is tempting: an Artifact is quick and looks good, but its content is
*written* rather than *derived*, which is precisely the property MISSION forbids for anything
owner-facing. It is fine for a one-off explanation, not for the standing view of the company.

## 4. What the screen shows, and where each field comes from

| Field | Source | Honest when empty |
|---|---|---|
| 30-day revenue, costs, net | `revenue_ledger`, summed via `computePortfolioSummary` | ₪0, shown plainly |
| Progress to ₪20,000 | ledger ÷ `revenue.target_monthly_agorot` | 0% |
| Run-rate | last 7 days of ledger, annualised | ₪0 |
| Per-line: status, 30d revenue, target, last decision | `revenue_lines` + `revenue_reviews` | status carries the truth (`awaiting_setup`) |
| **What the plan rests on** — measured / inferred / unevidenced | `TARGET_BASIS` in `portfolio.ts` | the whole point: ₪6,500 measured of a ₪16,500 sum |
| Needs you — one-time owner steps | `humanSetup` on lines where `human_setup_done = 0` | the list is the actionable part |
| Blockers this tick | `TickResult.blockers` | includes stalls and liveness gaps |
| Stalled lines | `findStalledLines` | "started and then nothing happened" |
| Sweep coverage | `sweepCoverage` over the `kv` table | 29/112 |
| Last tick, and gap since | `revenue.last_run.*` in `kv` | a stale timestamp is itself the alarm |

**What a manager would expect and we cannot honestly supply:** traffic and conversion per product
(no analytics deployed), per-line inference cost (not attributed yet), pipeline forecasts (we have
targets, not a pipeline), and anything about customers (we have none). The screen must not have
empty tiles for these — it should not have the tiles at all until the data exists.

## 5. The honest zero

The company has earned ₪0, and the plan's targets are ₪6,500 measured against a ₪20,000 goal with
₪8,500 resting on nothing. The screen has to say that without looking broken.

The approach: **lead with the state, not the number.** The headline is not a big ₪0 in a tile meant
for revenue — it is a plain sentence: no money has been earned yet, here is why, here is what
would change it. Then the "needs you" list, because that is the only section the owner can act on
today. Revenue history comes below, and it is allowed to be empty.

The rule to encode: a figure and its evidence grade always travel together. ₪16,500 never appears
without ₪6,500 measured beside it. A dashboard that shows the total alone is the fitted-arithmetic
failure in visual form.
